notes.title: New 0.18 Demo Update is finally available!
notes.notes:
I am very happy to say that we have some exciting updates to the Captain Hardcore Demo  🔥

Captain Hardcore Demo is now bigger and Better!

The full list of improvements is:


 NEW: Facial Expressions - 32 female and 17 male expressions, these are fine tuneable with sliders and it's even possible to mix different expressions. I'm planning to automate some of these in the future to create dynamic character reactions.
 NEW: Option for characters to stick out their tongue, this overrides the expression sliders.
 IMPROVED: The look at system has been re built from scratch. Head and eyes rotation now works perfectly, regardless of the overall character orientation. With the old system they would not rotate correctly when the character was on their back, side or upside down.
 IMPROVED: Increased the head constraint limits so that it can rotate further backwards.
 NEW: Smart look at mode - Characters gaze will automatically follow the player, toys and other characters when they notice them.
 IMPROVED: When a toy or other object is inserted into a characters mouth they'll only track movement with their eyes, this stops animations from being messed up!
 NEW: Option to hide the laser beams and red dot when the menu is closed.
 FIXED: Skin material settings could not be changed on the default character/scalp bug.
 IMPROVED: Better mouth and teeth textures + material.
 FIXED: Player falling through the floor in some situations when switching between edit and first person mode.
 FIXED: Gimbal lock issue that caused the head and eyes to glitch at certain angles.



Try the new features and let me know what you guys think.

Thanks, and have fun!

notes.title: Development Update Progress for PC
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,

It's time for our first development update of 2024! 👽👽👽

I intend to make more frequent dev updates throughout the year to keep everyone aware of the progress being made for Captain Hardcore. 

With that said, PC version 0.18 is going very well. Many new features are in progress, and a new large environment will create many new scene possibilities!

Facial Expressions

I'm working on more than 30 character expressions. These will all be fine-tuneable with sliders, but I plan to automate some for dynamic character reactions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600693/d2c5f713d9e52d5b3c3d4b8652cbd49ab98bcf44.gif

Tongue posing/animations

There will be controls for the tongue and new dynamic animations. Characters will automatically lick each other when in the correct position. This should also mean Aheago expressions will be possible! 👅

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600693/c348ee0805357f06e349a2a3ab8f1ebb59ae2e08.jpg

The "look at system" has been re-built from scratch


 Fixed a gimbal lock issue that caused the head and eyes to glitch at certain angles.
 Head and eye rotation now work perfectly, regardless of character orientation. With the old system, they would not rotate correctly when the character was on their back, side, or upside down.
 Increased the head constraint limits so that it can rotate further backward.

Smart look at mode

When they notice the player, toys, or other characters' faces or genitals, the characters' gazes automatically follow them. Also, when a toy or other object is inserted into their mouth, they only track movement with their eyes. This prevents animations from being messed up!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600693/39e79303fb3d3e02887d77cdf6fe7f37de439317.jpg

New environment: Suburban Neighbourhood

An entire street consisting of 16 houses, which are all enterable! This large environment opens up so many scene creation possibilities in a more "realistic" setting, and I can't wait to see what everyone does with it! There's even a button to switch between day and night mode! New spawnable furniture objects are also being added so that you can decorate the house interiors however you like.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600693/5aaa2d353bb705689f7a84d0371f95f8a120c89a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600693/90107773318755619918b1750845b2783ab13544.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600693/a9207ef28fefdffb40271d130116b348ff643ea0.jpg

We have more screenshots on our Discord server!

Overall, this is shaping to be a great addition to the game. I'm working hard to complete everything and keep improving the game for Steam. I will have more news about releasing on Steam during the next Steam Next Festival. Meanwhile, if you want to get early builds, you can get them here.

Last but not least, our friends at Lovense are hosting an exclusive discount for toys that can increase immersion while playing Captain Hardcore! It's a limited-time sale!

Thank you all for the incredible support! 👽👽👽

notes.title: It's Time to Celebrate Steam VR Fest With a New Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We are thrilled with the game's reception on Steam! Thank you to everyone that has already wishlisted Captain Hardcore! We believe that to celebrate Steam VR Fest, we should give something back to say thanks for your support so far.

We have updated the Captain Hardcore Demo to celebrate Steam VR Fest. Most of the new features from update 0.17 have been included! :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600693/d3238f4e6e0dd6ec7177770dd329f8146bca9e49.png

What's New in the Demo Update:

 NEW: 8 male skin pre-sets!
 NEW: 29 male face pre-sets!
 NEW: Over 140 male morph sliders!
 NEW: 10 male hairstyles!
 NEW: 16 male clothing items!
 NEW: 2 short female hairstyles.
 NEW: Adjust camera movement speed in desktop mode by scrolling with the mouse wheel while holding the right mouse button.
 Improved: Added a thrusting command to the Lovense integration for the Gravity toy.
 FIXED: UI bug when resetting morphs.
 FIXED: Issue with the male jaw physics constraint.


That also means that development officially entered its second phase! Now that the main sandbox features are completed we're looking forward to working on stage 2 including facial expressions, dynamic reactions, the orgasm/pleasure system, more interactive toy integrations and gameplay systems.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44600693/9d0c232bbfe7c43cf2abd4b6a1c69c650958ed5f.png
Thank you for being so hyped and so supportive! 

While we still don't have a release window for the game, the overwhelming response from the Steam community has truly been phenomenal. We're meticulously exploring every option to ensure a continuous stream of updates as the game evolves!

We can't wait for you to experience the updated demo and celebrate the experience of cutting-edge VR sex with us during Steam VR Fest!

Enjoy!
